metadata.description: Agent skills for search, RAG, parsing, completions, and model harnesses with Mixedbread.

plugins.name: mxbai-cli
plugins.description: Manage stores, upload files, search, and sync documents using the mxbai CLI tool.

plugins.name: mixedbread-search
plugins.description: Build and query managed search indexes (Stores) using the Mixedbread Python and TypeScript SDKs.

plugins.name: mixedbread-parsing
plugins.description: Parse documents, extract structured content, and run OCR using the Mixedbread Parsing API.

plugins.name: mixedbread-search-agent
plugins.description: Call Mixedbread's Toast-1 search model through the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs: hosted store tools, function tools, extension fields, terminal modes, context management, streaming, stored conversations.

plugins.name: mixedbread-search-agent-harness
plugins.description: Build your own harness around Mixedbread's Toast-1 search model: bounded rounds, parallel execution, evidence handles, stored-completion continuation, context management, terminal modes, a runnable loop, offline tests.
